title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'Sol Price is one of the greatest entrepreneurs of all time and yet most founders have never heard his name'
summary: Eric introduces the central founder figure of Incorruptible — FedMart's Sol Price, the customer-first operator who built the model Costco later inherited. 854 plays and 46 likes in 24 hours, the highest like count of any Eric TikTok this launch run.
blockquote: *Sol Price is one of the greatest entrepreneurs of all time and yet most founders have never heard his name*
